proves.claim: Cut into jobs by the previous census's row times, 2,000 skewed files give a largest job of at most 1.1 times the larger of total/80 and the heaviest file, every file runs once, and with no times jobs differ by at most one file.

cli.logic-census-balance.row-times-pack-.why: Without it, a regression that cuts a full census by file count again would leave one shard holding minutes of work beside near-empty ones.
